name: @objectstack/scenarios
description: Scenario-card schema and loader for the open scenario library under docs/qa/scenarios/. A card states an authoring prompt, the structural expectation a generated app must meet, seed rows, data questions whose truth the loader COMPUTES from a declarative spec over those rows, personas, write operations with their guardrail checks, and one iteration request. Not published, no build step, no model calls: a devx instrument, not a protocol (packages/spec carries no obligation for this format).
author: ObjectStack
